pr_title: ddl: fix alter int to bit will panic in backfill index
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: AilinKid <314806019@qq.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/24253

### What is changed and how it works?

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed:
Root cause:
When changing type A to type B, in the write reorg state, we will build a row decoder to analyze the raw data.
For the example in the issue.

| A | B | changing column A|
|  ----  | ----  | ---- |
| int | int | bit(5) |

|decoder.mutRow type|
| ---- |
|int int int|

for the decoder.mutRow, the TiDB set its fieldType as `int int int` rather than `int int bit(5）`

In the reorg second stage, we will fetch those reorganized rows to build the index again.
when analyzing an old row like `19,1,19(bit(5))`, it will set `19(bit(15))` datum to a mutRow with int type, which will panic here. 

Thus we change changing column to use it's target type as below:
|decoder.mutRow type|
| ---- |
|int int bit(5)|


Moreover, under this mechanism, when changing int to char(10), we build the mutRow type like:
|decoder.mutRow type|
| ---- |
|int int char(10)|

In the reorg first stage, we will fetch those old rows to rebuild the row again. it will try to set `int datum` to mut row with `char(10)`, which will also be leading panic here.


### Solution

As vividly illustrated above, we decided to set the decode.mutRow as the target field type that it has. But we don't analyze the changing column and generated column when we decode the row map. because:
- For changing column, we shouldn't decode it here, because we will do a unified cast operation latter.
- For generated column, we didn't decode it here too, because the eval process may depend on the changing column.

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- fix alter int to bit will panic in backfill index
